frontmatter.title: Autocomp: An ADRS Framework for Optimizing Tensor Accelerator Code
frontmatter.author: Charles Hong, Sahil Bhatia, Alvin Cheung, Yakun Sophia Shao, ADRS Team
frontmatter.excerpt: This post is the fifth in our ADRS series. We highlight Autocomp, the first LLM-driven code optimizer for low-resource tensor accelerators. Autocomp helps hardware designers extract the full performance of tensor accelerators, outperforming human expert kernel writers by up to 17x on AWS Trainium while being highly portable and easy to use.
